aiVerification.summary: Draft misidentifies the primary change and cannot be used as final evidence without regrouping.
issues: Changed factor is oven dry time reduction versus normal 20 minutes, not magnetic status.
Frame+SP and SMG conditions are mixed without subgroup structure.
Separate results omit key reduced-time, normal, and conclusion rows.
Capa outcome uses header-only evidence and unreliable statistics.
Tension rows lack full grouping context and baseline/test linkage.
correctionPlan: Rebuild changed factor as reduced oven dry time versus normal 20 minutes.
Use Frame+SP and SMG as subgroups under the same validation context.
Group outcomes as separate defect, capa, and tension within each subgroup.
Cite actual data rows plus headers and conclusion/decision rows for each outcome.
Remove header-only capa stats and recalculate from cited data rows.
aiVerification.evidencePolicy: Row IDs exist, but citations are insufficient and partly misgrouped.
